hebrewText: וַ/תֵּ֧לֶד אֵֽשֶׁת גִּלְעָ֛ד ל֖/וֹ בָּנִ֑ים וַ/יִּגְדְּל֨וּ בְֽנֵי הָ/אִשָּׁ֜ה וַ/יְגָרְשׁ֣וּ אֶת יִפְתָּ֗ח וַ/יֹּ֤אמְרוּ ל/וֹ֙ לֹֽא תִנְחַ֣ל בְּ/בֵית אָבִ֔י/נוּ כִּ֛י בֶּן אִשָּׁ֥ה אַחֶ֖רֶת אָֽתָּה

tokens.bdb: to bear young; causatively, to beget; medically, to act as midwife; specifically, to show lineage

tokens.kjv: (adulter) ess, each, every, female, [idiom] many, [phrase] none, one, [phrase] together, wife, woman. Often unexpressed in English.

tokens.kjv: Gilead, Gileadite.
